PAGE_HEADING: This account is already connected to another site
NOT_CONNECTED_NO_DOMAIN: We did not connect this WordPress site.
REASON: WordPress numbers posts separately on each site, so post 5 on one site and post 5 on another would share a single comment thread. To keep comments from mixing, each WordPress site needs its own FastComments account or tenant.
HEADING_REPLACES: This site replaces the old one
REPLACES_STEP_DEACTIVATE: Deactivate the FastComments plugin on the old site. Removing the site here only stops it syncing, and its comment widget keeps loading until the plugin is deactivated.
REPLACES_STEP_REMOVE: Remove the old site from the table above. We will bring you back here to finish connecting.
REPLACES_STEP_ASK_ADMIN: Ask an administrator who can manage data on this account to remove the old site, then try again.
REPLACES_NOTE: Comments already synced from the old site stay on this account, and they show on any post with the same ID on the new site.
TENANTS_DESCRIPTION: Tenants keep each site's comments, configuration, and users apart, and you manage them all from one login.
TENANTS_STEP_CREATE: Create a tenant for this site and switch to it.
TENANTS_STEP_RECONNECT: Go back to the plugin's setup page in WordPress and click "Yes, I have an account" again.
UPGRADE_DESCRIPTION: Plans with white labeling include tenants. Upgrade, then create a tenant for this site and connect it from the plugin's setup page.
SEPARATE_ACCOUNT_DESCRIPTION: Or create a separate FastComments account for this site. Log out, go back to the plugin's setup page in WordPress, click "No, create one", and sign up with a different email address.
